svg.aria-label: SQS Spring Boot operations and listener components
svg.text: SQS auto-configuration creates coroutine operations and optional listener containers with converter and interceptor hooks.

g.text: Listeners accept one payload-like argument plus at most one SqsAcknowledgement.
Failed messages are not deleted automatically; handlers should stay idempotent.

svg.text: SQS listeners wrap coroutine receive loops; deletion happens only after default or explicit acknowledgement.
